name: Ficus of Avenida de Salamanca

location.address: Avenida de Salamanca, beside the main entrance of Alicante's Alacant Terminal railway station (Estacion de Renfe)
location.neighbourhood: Ensanche, beside Alicante's main railway station

verified_sources: https://dadesobertes.gva.es/va/dataset/catalogo-de-arboles-monumentales-y-singulares-de-la-comunitat-valenciana (Generalitat Valenciana register, register_id 3096, girth 6.9m, height 28.0m, crown 28.2m, category Proteccion Generica)

https://www.alicante.es/es/noticias/ayuntamiento-instala-placas-informativas-poner-valor-sus-ficus-monumentales (city confirms an information panel was installed at 'Avenida de Salamanca, en la estacion de Ferrocarril' as one of six sites with the highest concentration of monumental ficus)

https://alicantepress.com/archive/39987/alicante-instala-informacion-en-los-36-ficus-monumentales (independent press corroboration: 'junto a la fachada principal de la estacion del tren (Renfe) hay tres ficus con jardinera', i.e. three ficus in planters beside the station's main facade)

https://www.todoalicante.es/alicante-ciudad/plaza-estrella-puerta-entrada-parque-central-alicante-20260420005022-nt.html (2026-04-20, describes 'century-old ficus trees' (ficus centenarios) at the Salamanca/Aguilera intersection as the anchor of the future Plaza de la Estrella entrance to the Parque Central project)
access: Free, on the public pavement/forecourt of Avenida de Salamanca directly outside the main entrance of Alicante's Alacant Terminal railway station, no gate or opening hours. Caveat: the adjoining Plaza de la Estrella immediately beside it (at the Salamanca/Aguilera intersection) is, as of an April 2026 news report, still a fenced-off area under redevelopment for the Parque Central project; this specific tree stands on the station forecourt itself, not inside that construction site, but a writer/reader should be told the area is mid-redevelopment.
transport: Directly outside Alicante's main railway station, Alacant Terminal / Estacion de Renfe, Avenida de Salamanca
verify_notes: Largest and tallest of a tight trio of Ficus macrophylla registered right beside the RENFE/Alacant Terminal station's main facade (register_ids 3096, 3097, 3098; 3096 chosen as the shipped entry because it is the tallest, 28m, and thickest of the three, 6.9m girth, vs 6.5m/20m and 6.7m/20m for its two neighbours 7-58m away). All three are 'planter figs' beside the station facade per independent press (alicantepress), which independently corroborates the register's location and the city's own confirmation that this is one of six sites citywide chosen for a monumental-ficus information panel (alicante.es). A 2026-04-20 todoalicante piece on the adjacent Plaza de la Estrella redevelopment (Parque Central project, kilometre zero of a 2.1km green corridor, due to complete ~2028-2029) calls the ficus population of this intersection 'centenarios' (century-old) and says they will be preserved and become the 'guardians' of the new southern entrance to the city; that is a general area description, not a dated planting record for this individual tree, so age is left undocumented rather than derived from it (avoiding the bridge-claim trap). The same piece also floats a claim, attributed to 'Spain's Forest Map' via secondary reporting, that this plaza holds one of the most notable individual ficus specimens in the country; not independently confirmed and not used here, flagged for a writer to check before using as a superlative. Category in the regional register is 'Proteccion Generica' rather than 'Arbol Monumental de Interes Local' (the category the other 9 Alicante trees carry); the register's own caveat says this generic tier applies automatically regardless of ownership, but the multiple independent confirmations of a public station-facade location (not a private plot) resolve that concern for this specific tree. Companion candidates 3097 and 3098 (same trio, 7m and 58m away) and 3099 (a fourth Ficus macrophylla under the same 'Proteccion Generica' registration but ~0.9km further away on Carrer de l'Esportista Ramon Mendizabal, a more residential street, not part of this station cluster) are recorded in data/leads/alicante.json rather than shipped, to avoid fragmenting one small station-forecourt grove into near-identical collectible points, matching the precedent already set for register_ids 300/302 in Parque de Canalejas.
